title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on diligence, wisdom and noble conduct
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam  highlighting the importance of wisdom, diligence and noble conduct in the creation of a virtuous society. The verse urges individuals to follow the path of light and wisdom, remain vigilant and steadfast in their efforts, and contribute towards building a noble and virtuous society:
"तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान्।
अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्॥"
The Prime Minister posted on X:

अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्॥
